Newmans Nosh back at Moodys!!

title: Tunes on Tap
description:
How has it been, a week, since this glorious, Tunes on Tap evening, already?! 

The one where My Tiny Hand, met Piss Crystals, met Rebecca 😁

We love being graced, with talented local musicians, any musicians, to be fair, as it’s always, a cracking time, when music and people, are joined together

Tunes on Tap, is every third Wednesday, each month, so keep up to date, on our socials, as to who will be joining us, on the 21st of October! 

For now, come and join us, from 3pm - 11pm (daily) for everything from board games to retro games consoles, plenty of art materials, or have a chat, bring your mates, or bring a book, and have a relaxing time, in your local living room

See you soon!

Lovely Sue (photos by me 😁)
